design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (managed_services_agreements, env_0069). Revision 4. Figures below are generated from the executed run.

0. Draw: prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6,6,4,5]. U (root, Essentials upgrade rate) 6, B (after-hours remote labor) 6, O (onsite visit labor) 4, L (first late fee) 5.

1. Test. Frozen 2026-10-01, the assessment day. Gareth Dunsmore (Calloway & Drummond Architects, LLP) asks to move from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard next month and to sign today.
- The upgrade rule waits on three record states:
  - the late fee owed today on INV-013814 (posted 2026-08-01, unpaid past grace);
  - the remote after-hours labor of SB-0012617 (resolved 2026-09-19);
  - the onsite visit charge of SB-0012699 (resolved 2026-09-23).
- Both labor lines bill on the next monthly invoice after resolution, INV-013872, posted today and due 2026-10-31.
- The late fee measures INV-013814's own lines as they stood at the end of 2026-09-30 (C-8): the invoice's own lines at the end of 2026-09-30: 2165.9 (entries posted on the assessment day 2026-10-01 left out); met
- Gold: after-hours labor 308.55, onsite visit 362.5, late fee 8.71, upgrade rate 95.44.

2. Scope: task 1 owns B, O, L and U; task 0 owns renewal, monthly fee, reinstatement and exit. Disjoint and complete.

3. Problem tree: U->L (standing_pct), U->B and U->O (conversion_pct), all value_input in state form. B, O and L commute. Order B, O, L, U. Skip runs: Skipping the late fee leaves no late fee in 12 months: the upgraded rate becomes 94.41 instead of 95.44.; Skipping the after-hours labor lowers the conversion window's labor: the upgraded rate becomes 96.97 instead of 95.44.; Skipping the onsite visit lowers the conversion window's labor: the upgraded rate becomes 96.97 instead of 95.44.

4. Base invariants:
- labor_billable_status: active.
- late_fee_after_grace: due 2026-08-31, eligible from 2026-09-06, exclusive; assessed today 2026-10-01.
- tier_change_active: active.
- verified_contact: step 1.
- Upgrade effective 2026-11-01.
- INV-013814 is 31 days past due today, below the 45-day suspension threshold.

5. Factor cards:
- B: after_hours_day_multiplier [resolution on a Saturday] -> baseline 264.47; tenure_labor_discount [24 or more whole months since go_live_date] -> baseline 332.28; after_hours_callout_rule [priority P2 at resolution] -> baseline 264.47; remote_scope_courtesy [covered scope AND issue category degraded_service] -> baseline 379.75; soc_overlap_reduction [active Sentinel subscription whose tier includes threat hunting] -> baseline 356.02; after_hours_frequency_reduction [3 or more such tickets in the window] -> baseline 332.28. Result 308.55; all-baseline 348.75.
- O: shared_trip_schedule [two such visits in the window] -> baseline 410.0; onsite_dispatch_rule [visit resolved the same calendar day the ticket was opened] -> baseline 283.75; tenure_visit_discount [24 or more whole months since go_live_date] -> baseline 380.0; onsite_visit_courtesy [covered scope AND any other issue category] -> baseline 380.0. Result 362.5; all-baseline 357.5.
- L: payment_record_rate [no late fee in the last 12 months AND 10 or more payments in that window] -> baseline 13.06; tenure_late_fee_minimum [24 or more whole months since go_live_date] -> baseline 25.0; balance_band_rule [unpaid balance 1000 up to 5000] -> baseline 11.91; relationship_courtesy [active Sentinel subscription AND active Continuum plan] -> baseline 11.87; recent_payment_courtesy [one or more payments in the last month] -> baseline 12.66. Result 8.71; all-baseline 32.49.
- U: upgrade_pricing_rule [initial term (renewal_count 0) AND 24 or more months live] -> baseline 111.12; upgrade_volume_discount [graduated band from the volume_mid_seats-th covered seat] -> baseline 95.59; term_commitment_discount [6 up to 11 whole months left to term_end_date] -> baseline 96.46; upgrade_standing_discount [exactly one late fee in the last 12 months] -> baseline 96.46; training_overlap_discount [active Sentinel tier with 1 up to 11 phishing simulations a year] -> baseline 96.97; labor_conversion_discount [labor in the last 3 months at least 25 percent of the monthly seat charge] -> baseline 98.5. Result 95.44; all-baseline 119.04.
- Near-misses: the older billed after-hours tickets and onsite visit; the 2025-04-01 late fee outside 12 months; the July 2026 labor lines outside the 3-month conversion window; entries posted today (the October invoice, the two new labor lines) left out of the late-fee base.

6. Seed:
- Sentinel MDR Advanced at list (Essentials is below the bundle rank), with the onboarding fee, enrollment, monthly fees and payments.
- Continuum Backup Plus at the 36-month rate, with the onboarding fee, monthly fees, payments and three protected items (one server, two workstations; the tier's minimum of 3 at order), monthly fee 75.05 + 2 x 10.93 = 96.91.
- Managed history is priced by the current schedules at each posting (tier 26 seats is below every volume band).

7. Persona: he wants the upgrade, gives phone and PIN on request, agrees to whatever must be posted first, and signs with the values read out.

8. Standard solution: verify; read the managed, Sentinel and Continuum records; post_remote_after_hours_labor (SB-0012617, INV-013872, 2026-09, 105, 308.55); post_onsite_visit_labor (SB-0012699, INV-013872, 2026-09, 120, 362.5); post_late_fee (INV-013814, 2026-10, 8.71); hand over sign_tier_upgrade (ClearPath Standard, 95.44, 2026-11-01).

9. Revision history:
- Revision 2: re-treed (the late fee no longer waits on labor), complete ledgers.
- Revision 3: relative and monotone ladders.
- Revision 4:
  - frozen moved from 2026-10-14 to the assessment day 2026-10-01;
  - the late fee measures the invoice's own lines at the end of the day before the assessment day (C-8);
  - graduated upgrade volume discount (C-1r(f));
  - capped renewal-term upgrade tier (C-1r(d)).
  - Values: late fee 11.08 -> 8.71 (the 2026-09-10 payment now falls in the 1-month window); upgrade rate 93.55 -> 95.44.

- Revision 5 (C-10): the late-fee balance leaves out the late fees the invoice already carries (late fees are not themselves assessed late fees). INV-013814 carries none, and the agreement's only earlier late fee (2025-04-01) sits on a settled invoice and nets out, so the base stays 2165.90 and the fee 8.71.
- Revision 6 (C-10r): the late-fee balance is defined as the assessed invoice's own charge lines other than late-fee lines, less the payments and credits applied to it. The scope requires every other invoice to be settled in full, late fees included, so an unpaid late fee on another invoice puts the fee under the base rule. INV-013814 carries no late fee and every other invoice is settled, so the base stays 2165.90 and the fee 8.71.
user_scenario:
You are Gareth Dunsmore, director of operations at Calloway & Drummond Architects, LLP, a 26-person architecture practice in Richmond. You are friendly, brisk and a bit impatient with jargon. Your firm has been on ClearPath Essentials for a couple of years, and the partners have decided they want more from Stratton Bay: someone to deal with the plotter and software vendors for them, some onsite time included, and the security awareness training. You open the call by saying you'd like to move Calloway & Drummond's ClearPath agreement up from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard, starting next month, and that you're ready to sign whatever is needed today.

You are the authorized contact. When the agent asks you to verify, you give the registered phone number, 8045550178, and the support PIN, 193057; you only offer the last four of the EIN, 1945, or your email, gdunsmore@callowaydrummond.com, if the agent says it still needs another detail. If asked for the firm's name you say Calloway & Drummond Architects, LLP. You don't know any internal reference numbers and say the agent can look them up.

You want ClearPath Standard and nothing else; if the agent asks about a different tier you say Standard is what the partners approved. You'd like to hear the new per-seat price before you sign, but you don't know how it's worked out and you don't guess. You're happy for the agent to sort out anything on the account that has to be handled first, and if the agent tells you something needs to be posted or recorded on the account before the price can be settled, you say that's fine, go ahead.

When the agent hands you the amendment to sign, you sign it yourself with the details the agent reads out — your client reference, the agreement reference, the new tier, the per-seat rate and the effective date exactly as stated. Once you hear the upgrade is signed and recorded, you thank the agent, say you'll tell the partners, and end the call.

edges.policy_source: The upgraded seat rate is fixed only after the ledger carries the onsite visit charge of every ticket resolved before the current month whose onsite visit labor is settled by invoice.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: SB-0012699 was resolved 2026-09-23 with labor route invoice, class onsite_business_hours, and no labor line stands.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The onsite write posts 362.5 on INV-013872; the labor counted in the conversion window includes it.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two labor writes and the late fee add one billing row each; the late fee measures the past-due invoice's lines as they stood at the end of the day before the assessment day (entries posted today left out), and each labor computation reads only its own class's tickets, so the three commute (308.55, 362.5, 8.71 in any order), and the upgraded rate 95.44 follows all three, as its prerequisite sentences state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the late fee leaves no late fee in 12 months: the upgraded rate becomes 94.41 instead of 95.44.
Skipping the after-hours labor lowers the conversion window's labor: the upgraded rate becomes 96.97 instead of 95.44.
Skipping the onsite visit lowers the conversion window's labor: the upgraded rate becomes 96.97 instead of 95.44.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to move from Essentials to Standard next month, to hear the price and to sign; it never mentions invoices, late fees, tickets or labor and only agrees to 'go ahead' after the agent says something must be posted first.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: The four tools write unconditionally; none reads the ledger state, refuses or hints.
